name: ENGL 150

ai_level.quote: Unless an assignment says otherwise, you may use AI to brainstorm, outline, and find sources, but every sentence you submit must be your own.
Reflections are written without AI tools of any kind.
For the final project you may work with AI on drafting and revision, and you must say how.

guidance.rule: AI may help plan, but the writing must be your own.
